name: upgrade-guard
title_zh: 升级前先拍快照，翻车一键回滚的 OpenClaw 守
tagline_zh: 再也不用赌「这次升级应该没事」。自动快照 + 预检 + 分步升级 + 事后验证，坏了大不了回滚。
tagline_en: Stop gambling on updates. Auto snapshot, pre-flight checks, staged upgrade, post-verify, and one-command rollback.
desc_en: Safe OpenClaw upgrades with snapshot, pre-flight checks, controlled upgrade steps, post-verification, and emergency rollback. Never lose your working system to a bad update again.
why_zh: 把「升级」从一次性冒险拆成可回退的检查点流程。每一步都留后路，验证不过就停，而不是等系统崩了才后悔。
why_en: Turns upgrades into checkpointed, reversible steps. Each stage verifies before moving on; if anything fails, you rewind—not.
limit_zh: 只守护 OpenClaw 自身的升级流程，不覆盖插件或系统级依赖变更。回滚依赖升级前自动快照。
limit_en: Only guards OpenClaw core upgrades, not plugins or OS deps. Rollback relies on its pre-upgrade snapshot; manually edited files aren't covered.
title_en: OpenClaw upgrade guard: snapshot, verify, rollback
